[1/5] Branching quantum message trees with per-choice outcomes and follow-up branches; Dyson spheres and additional themed celestial objects

impact_assessment.why: User requested a messaging revamp with message trees, Dyson spheres, more objects, quantum technologies, weapons, crew, recruiting, portraits, and a fitting in-game date.
impact_assessment.benefits: Messages become decision trees with persistent consequences; megastructures and themed objects expand exploration and production; later milestones add quantum tech, weapon variety, and crew.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: QuantumMessage save compatibility; dependency: none; concurrency: engine lock; state: message choices must be deterministic and saved atomically.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add defaulted model fields, pure tree catalog, failing-first tests, and backward-compatible serialization.

[1/5] Plan: resolution-adaptive cockpit UI and radar, new salvage/scoop/crew-drill mechanics, JS/engine bug fixes, docs and gates

impact_assessment.why: User asked for a resolution-adaptive VoidFarer UI, more mechanics, and bug fixes/improvements.
impact_assessment.benefits: Cockpit stays usable from phone to 4K with DPR-crisp radar and touch input; three new risk/reward mechanics deepen exploration and crew play; polling/hotkey/resize bugs are fixed.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: G-001..G-010 layout rules and save compatibility must hold; dependency: stdlib and vanilla JS only; concurrency: engine lock and server ticker preserved; state: legacy saves need defaulted CelestialBody.salvage_claimed without RNG drift.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add defaulted model fields, keep base CSS rules intact and append media queries, add failing-first tests before code, run the full suite plus aikit check.

[1/6] Plan: captain's log and discovery codex with persistent claimed milestones, derived statistics, achievement rewards, and CLI/REST/cockpit parity

impact_assessment.why: User chose a persistent discovery journal, codex entries, statistics and achievement rewards as the next Voidfarer feature.
impact_assessment.benefits: Gives long-term goals across exploration, command, commerce, combat and story; rewards existing play; surfaces progress the game already tracks but never displays.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: GameState save schema and existing G-001..G-012 layout rules must hold; dependency: stdlib and vanilla JS only; concurrency: engine lock and server ticker preserved; state: legacy saves need a defaulted CodexState and claimed milestones must persist atomically.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add a defaulted frozen CodexState, derive progress from existing GameState/stats, persist only claimed ids and dates, add failing-first tests, and append CSS without altering base layout rules.
